correctness.rationale: PASS. Retrieved frozen RESULT.md, complete independent-check source and other package files. A fixed barycentric point must use entire graph-edge orbits; admissible orbits are singleton edges joining each swapped pair, two perfect-pair alternatives between distinct swapped blocks, plus fixed–fixed ordinary edges. Mixed swapped–fixed edge orbits are inadmissible because their two edges share a fixed endpoint. Hence orbit complex is O_m*M_r. The contractible cone L_m*O_{m−1} and 2(m−1) cones over O_{m−2} attach with pairwise overlaps inside the cone; collapsing it gives recurrence O_m≈∨^{2(m−1)}Σ O_{m−2}. Base O1 point, O2 edge plus two isolates, and r=0,1,2 join edge cases prove odd contractibility and even (2k)!/k! wedge/suspension formula without unproven assumptions on M_r. Verified independently by rebuilding the full block-support face enumeration and reduced Euler characteristic for m=1..7 (face polynomial examples m4: [1,16,42,16,1], χ̃=−12; m6 χ̃=120), agreeing with the recurrence. The published integral M7 groups H1=Z/3 and H2=Z^20 are explicitly confirmed in Mondal–Mukherjee–Saha Theorem1.3, producing the stated fixed torsion via two suspensions. Finite checks are not substituted for the homotopy recurrence.

originality.rationale: PASS (best of knowledge). Read Wachs 2003 primary PDF §8 Theorems8.3–8.4: inflation of ordinary matching complexes and uniformly colored multigraphs, including suspensions, is close but not the loop-augmented orbit complex with singleton block vertices. Read Mondal–Mukherjee–Saha 2024 main theorem PDF: computes ordinary M7 and general ordinary Morse connectivity; does not give all involution geometric fixed spaces. The M7 torsion and the generic suspension machinery are PRIOR, credited. The structural new work is exact orbit classification under each involution and cone recurrence. Beware unindexed general fixed-subgroup formulas.

A COMPLETE all-involution fixed-locus homotopy classification is a natural equivariant topology invariant and gives parity contractibility, factorial multiplicity, and integral torsion transfers. Ordinary homology or representation characters are insufficient substitutes. The recurrence and join boundary cases are structural, not arbitrary small examples or renaming of known inflation.
